kinds.PROVEN: mathematical theorem, proved or recomputed here
kinds.IMPORT: published result used exactly as published
kinds.POSTULATE: assumed; not derivable from the other nodes at present
kinds.INPUT: measured number that enters a choice or a formula
kinds.DERIVED: follows from PROVEN/IMPORT/POSTULATE/INPUT nodes and passes gates G1-G10
kinds.OBSERVATION: numerical agreement found after the target was known; not derived
kinds.FAILS: contradicted by a computation or by the record
kinds.CONJECTURE: open mathematical statement used as an assumption; listed wherever it is used
kinds.CONDITIONAL: theorem proved from PROVEN/IMPORT nodes plus at least one CONJECTURE

Read as the on-shell (Q^2 = 0) value it differs from CODATA 2022, alpha^-1 = 137.035999177(21), by 1.6936e-5 (0.124 ppm, 806 sigma). The manuscript assigns the gap to the bridge C2, whose scale Q* is obtained by inverting the measured alpha, so the exact claim sits in C2. Law 1 rests on P8, which no published X_5 mechanism supplies; the one published mechanism that can supply P8's factor 3, a Kac-Moody level, fails the measured couplings by itself (NYS). Lean: Law 1 follows exactly from P2, P8, P9 (UGCT.Physics.law1); the kernel cannot see that P8 was chosen after the target was known. Evolutionary search (EVO, three pre-registered generations): no construct the hard constraints admit has grade 1 (T15, T17; conditional on K1), no charge of X_5 couples as weakly as 1/137 (T14), and Law 1's one grade-1 factor is the Laplace factor of the affine chart (T16). Generation 4 (EVO): Law 1 is not a monomial in pi, Qbar and Fermat periods of any degree (T18, conditional on K2), and its smallest integral realization in the four-field model is 2 Law 1 (T19). X_5 dictionary scans (X5ACC): no product of up to three of 47 X_5 numbers gives alpha^-1 within 2 sigma, Law 1 being the closest of 24.8 million (T21); in a dictionary of that size a form as close as Law 1 occurs for 12% of random targets, so its accuracy is not significant there (0.3% in the 277k Gamma family)
nodes.action: Make exact through C2: derive delta = alpha^-1(0) - pi Gamma(1/5)^3/Gamma(2/5) = 1.6936(21)e-5 without the measured alpha and freeze it before comparison (G2, G8). Until then state Law 1 as an observation with its look-elsewhere odds (~3e-5 in its own family), and keep P8 and P9 as named postulates. X_5 alone cannot supply Law 1 exactly under the hard constraints (T14, T15, T17), so a derivation must add one physical object of scale weight 1/5 (EVO, relaxations R1-R3). Such an object is an exponential, not a classical, period (T18), and Dirac-quantized charges give 2 Law 1 (T19).
